modules.name: Number and Numeration
modules.description: Fundamental concepts in arithmetic, indices, logarithms, and number bases.

concepts.title: Basic Operations
concepts.content: Operations with fractions include addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division. Fractions can be simplified using the Greatest Common Factor (GCF)[cite: 10, 11].

concepts.title: LCM and HCF
concepts.content: The Least Common Multiple (LCM) is the smallest number multiple of two or more numbers. The Highest Common Factor (HCF) is the largest number that divides them without remainder[cite: 13, 14].

exercises.title: Addition of Fractions
exercises.solution: 1. Find LCM of 4 and 6 (12). 2. Convert: $\frac{9}{12} + \frac{10}{12}$. 3. Result: $\frac{19}{12}$[cite: 17, 19, 21].

concepts.title: Laws of Indices
concepts.content: Includes Product Rule ($a^m \cdot a^n = a^{m+n}$), Quotient Rule ($\frac{a^m}{a^n} = a^{m-n}$), and Zero Exponent Rule ($a^0 = 1$)[cite: 46, 47, 48, 50].

concepts.title: Base Systems
concepts.content: Common bases include Base 10 (Decimal), Base 2 (Binary), and Base 16 (Hexadecimal). Conversion involves successive division[cite: 73, 74, 75, 77].

modules.name: Algebra
modules.description: Algebraic expressions, equations, inequalities, and sequences.

concepts.title: Simplification and Factorization
concepts.content: Combining like terms and rewriting expressions as products. Key identity: $a^2 - b^2 = (a-b)(a+b)$[cite: 289, 291, 292].

concepts.title: Linear and Simultaneous Equations
concepts.content: Solving for variables in statements like $ax+b=0$ or sets of multiple variables[cite: 338, 339].

concepts.title: Quadratic Formula
concepts.content: Equations of form $ax^2 + bx + c = 0$. Solutions via $x = \frac{-b \pm \sqrt{b^2 - 4ac}}{2a}$[cite: 428, 431].

concepts.title: The Discriminant
concepts.content: $\Delta = b^2 - 4ac$ determines root nature: $\Delta > 0$ (2 real roots), $\Delta = 0$ (1 real root), $\Delta < 0$ (no real roots)[cite: 436, 438, 440, 442].

modules.name: Geometry and Mensuration
modules.description: Plane geometry, circles, and 3D shapes calculations.

concepts.title: Triangle Properties
concepts.content: The sum of interior angles is $180^\circ$. Pythagoras Theorem: $c^2 = a^2 + b^2$ for right-angled triangles[cite: 740, 747, 749].

concepts.title: Polygons
concepts.content: Sum of internal angles: $(n-2) \times 180^\circ$. Sum of external angles is always $360^\circ$[cite: 760, 762].

concepts.title: Circle Theorems
concepts.content: Angle at center is twice the angle at circumference. Angles in a semicircle are $90^\circ$[cite: 824, 825].

exercises.title: Circumference
exercises.statement: Find the circumference of a circle with radius 7 cm.
